frozen_at: 2026-11-19, before any study call (two feasibility calls on 김치볶음밥 Lf44Fk7H24s and 계란말이 kN89ewZjOR8 with gemini-2.5-flash-lite came first and are reported separately)
question: Can a Gemini model that watches the public YouTube video write a structured recipe as good as, or better than, the one restructured from the same video's captions, and which model should build the stored recipe file?

inputs.dishes: the 16 dishes that have a caption-based recipe (artifacts copy of the caption recipes, not in git)
inputs.video_per_dish: the same video the caption-based recipe was written from
inputs.reference: the caption-based recipe (an AI restructuring of auto or manual captions; not a human label)

fixed_settings.route: OpenRouter chat completions, video_url part with the YouTube watch URL, provider pinned to Google AI Studio without fallbacks
fixed_settings.media_resolution: provider default (OpenRouter documents no media-resolution parameter)
fixed_settings.retries: HTTP 429 retried after 3 s and 8 s, as the server does

metrics: answer received and recipe valid against schema.json and the form rules of validate_recipe
identity: the model's is_requested_dish and cooked_dish per dish
ingredient agreement with the caption-based recipe: precision and recall on names after spaces are removed and synonym groups are merged

ingredients in the video recipe whose name is not in the captions, each reviewed by hand as seen-on-screen plausible, invented, or unclear (from the title, description and caption context); the model's own evidence label (heard, seen, both) is reported next to it
share of ingredients with an amount; servings given or not
role labels: counts of main, secondary, seasoning, and main-label agreement with the caption-based recipe on shared ingredients
prompt and completion tokens, cost (OpenRouter usage.cost), latency
analysis_plan: Per dish, paired lite vs flash and each vs captions; report every number in tables with the per-dish values, medians and the full ranges; add a side-by-side reading of 6 dishes (Korean notes). No pass/fail thresholds: the choice of source and model for the stored file is a judgement written next to the numbers, with its limits.
budget: at most 40 model calls and $2 for this study (one run per variant per dish)
limits_known_before_running: the reference is itself AI-made from captions, so disagreement does not say which side is wrong
one run per variant; the hand review is one reviewer (the AI that wrote the study)
the model sees about one frame per second and the audio; quick on-screen text may be missed
